segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making the time. I have the quote updated for 42 seats, annual term, starting March 1. It comes out to $31,920 for the year before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I expected. The only thing I want to confirm is the services line. Is that still the one-time onboarding at $4,800?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. That includes the kickoff, two admin training sessions, and import help for up to 18,000 contacts. If you go over that, we would just scope it before doing anything.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. We are probably around 14,500 records, so that should be fine. For timing, if we sign this week, are we still looking at April 15 for go-live?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If the order form is signed by Friday, we can start onboarding March 11 and target April 15. There is a little buffer in there for your sandbox review.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On billing, can you split the annual invoice into two payments, March and September?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, we can do semiannual billing. It would be $15,960 due at contract start and the same amount due September 1. The onboarding fee would be on the first invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Legal had one note on the renewal. They want 60 days' notice instead of 90 for non-renewal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That is within our standard fallback. I can have deal desk update the order form to 60 days and send a clean copy this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy procurement. If it looks right, I can route it for signature tomorrow.
